conditions.b2b_1st: team plays the next day, did not play the previous day
conditions.rested: 1+ days off before, no game next day (season openers excluded)

definitions.scopes: 2025-26, 2026-27 (through cutoff), combined = the player's games from both seasons pooled
definitions.qualifies: >= 3 games in each condition of the comparison
definitions.raw: player's mean pts in A minus mean pts in B
definitions.se: sd * sqrt(1/n_a + 1/n_b), sd = the player's game-to-game pts SD over all his games in the scope
definitions.ci95: raw +/- t(0.975, df = player's games in scope - 1) * se
definitions.shrunk: empirical-Bayes estimate: league + w*(raw - league), w = tau^2/(tau^2+se^2); tau^2 = DerSimonian-Laird between-player variance across qualifying players (same scope & comparison); shrinks toward the displayed league pts_mean
definitions.percentile: rank of shrunk among all qualifying league players (0-100, midrank)
definitions.p_q: p = two-sided normal p of z; q = Benjamini-Hochberg q-value across qualifying players in the same scope & comparison
definitions.flag: <above|below>_league_strong when q < 0.1; <above|below>_league_watch when |z| >= 2.5 (nominal, not multiplicity-adjusted); else null
definitions.league: baseline over ALL players with games (not only app players): comparisons = mean/median of qualifying players' raw; conditions = mean of player condition means (players with >= 3 games in it)
definitions.minutes_per36: raw differences only (minutes CI built the same way as pts); shrinkage/z/flag apply to pts
definitions.games: regular season (002) incl. NBA Cup group/knockout; no Cup final, playoffs, play-in; minutes > 0 only

ranking_note: by_shrunk ties break on raw, then player_id. shrunk_is_flat = league tau < 0.1 pt: individual effects are indistinguishable from noise and every shrunk value sits within a few hundredths of the league mean, so prefer by_raw with CIs for display
ranking_population: app players (data/betting_points.json) that qualify; percentiles/baselines use all league players

caveats: 2026-27 is a very small sample; most players do not qualify and no one qualifies for B2B comparisons yet.
'watch' flags are nominal: with ~400-500 players per comparison, ~1.2% (~5) would reach |z|>=2.5 by chance. Only 'strong' (FDR q<0.1) survives multiple testing.
Observational: rest decisions are not random; players held out are not in the data.
